description: A board finance committee chair must decide whether to authorize a special dividend and finalize its funding conditions and payment mix, with input from financial control, pension treasury, and corporate legal.

shared_context.S1: The company has requested approval for a special dividend of up to $8,000,000 after reporting a profitable quarter.
shared_context.S2: The company currently has $12,000,000 of unrestricted cash.
shared_context.S3: Mara chairs the committee and makes the binding decision on the distribution proposal.
shared_context.S4: At the monthly capital-distribution meeting, Mara asks financial control, pension treasury, and corporate legal to report any items that must be reflected before the proposal is finalized.

PF1.text: Elias received the finalized quarter-end audit note this morning showing that legally distributable reserves available for this special dividend are exactly $5,700,000, rather than the $8,000,000 amount in the internal draft; the note has not yet been circulated to the committee.

PF2.text: Nadia confirmed with the pension trustee this week that a $1,500,000 contribution must be funded before the company declares any special dividend; she recorded the confirmation in her treasury file but has not uploaded it to the distribution folder.

PF3.text: Jonah found in the shareholder agreement while reviewing it this week that at least 40% of a special dividend must be paid as scrip shares, with the remainder payable in cash; he has not yet sent the clause to the committee secretary.

acceptance_conditions: The special dividend must be approved.
The approved special dividend must be exactly $5,700,000.
A $1,500,000 pension contribution must be funded before the dividend is declared.
The cash portion of the dividend must be exactly $3,420,000.
The scrip portion of the dividend must be exactly $2,280,000.
The settlement must include commitments for the required pension contribution and scrip issuance.

content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'pension_contribution' for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] == 'scrip_issuance' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: all(c in credited_facts for c in ['PF1', 'PF2', 'PF3'])

decisive_facts.why: The internal proposal allows up to $8,000,000, but PF1 changes the legally permissible special-dividend amount to exactly $5,700,000 and supplies the required cited basis for that amount.
Without PF2, the settlement would set no pre-declaration pension contribution and would omit the required $1,500,000 pension-contribution commitment.

Without PF3, a generic all-cash dividend would set cash at $5,700,000 and scrip at $0, whereas the agreement changes those amounts to exactly $3,420,000 cash and $2,280,000 scrip and requires a scrip-issuance commitment.
